## ✅ Task breakdown ready — `specs/001-bookmark-manager/tasks.md`

**66 tasks** across 15 phases, organized so each user story is an independently testable increment.

| Phase | Scope | Tasks |
|---|---|---|
| 1 — Setup | package.json, deps (pinned), dir tree, harness `app.json`, Playwright config | T001–T005 |
| 2 — Foundational ⚠️ | DB schema+migrations, URL normalization, Express server + error handling, frontend shell + `data-harness-ready` | T006–T010 |
| 3 — **US1 (P1)** 🎯 | Save with pre-save review, metadata, async offline capture, duplicate→open existing | T011–T018 |
| 4 — **US2 (P1)** | Rich list rows, sort, advanced search parser | T019–T024 |
| 5 — US3 (P2) | Read-later + unread view | T025–T027 |
| 6 — US4 (P2) | Edit & delete | T028–T030 |
| 7 — US5 (P2) | Tags + suggestions + filter | T031–T034 |
| 8 — US6 (P2) | Bulk actions (incl. select-all-matching) | T035–T037 |
| 9 — US7 (P2) | Reversible archive + archive view | T038–T040 |
| 10 — US8 (P3) | Formatted notes (sanitized) | T041–T044 |
| 11 — US9 (P3) | Saved filters | T045–T048 |
| 12 — US10 (P3) | Offline-copy viewing, PDF-as-PDF, Internet Archive | T049–T053 |
| 13 — US11 (P3) | Import/export (browser HTML) | T054–T058 |
| 14 — US12 (P3) | Display preferences | T059–T061 |
| 15 — Polish | Perf/accessibility/degradation, quickstart validation | T062–T066 |

**Tests included** (per the approved plan's testing strategy): unit tests for the two riskiest pieces — the search parser (T020) and import/export round-trip (T055) — plus a URL-normalization unit test (T008), and a Playwright e2e test per story.

**Parallelism:** independent service modules in separate files are marked `[P]`; tasks that share `server/routes/bookmarks.js` or `public/app.js` are sequenced to avoid conflicts.

**Suggested MVP:** Phases 1–2 + **US1 + US2** (save → review → confirm, then browse/sort/search) — a demoable product on its own.

**One mapping decision worth noting:** the automatic offline-copy *capture* lives in **US1** (it's part of the approved save flow), while **US10** adds viewing the stored copy, PDF confirmation, and the optional Internet Archive action. This keeps US1 a self-contained MVP.

---

**At this gate**, your options:
1. **Approve** → I proceed to `speckit-implement` (build against these tasks), starting with the MVP.
2. Ask me to run **`speckit-analyze`** first — a non-destructive cross-check of spec ↔ plan ↔ tasks consistency before building.
3. Request changes to the breakdown (e.g., reprioritize, defer P3 stories, adjust the MVP scope).
